description: This file defines an abstract class OverlayDisplayWindow and two implementations for managing overlay windows on Android devices. It is used for creating, showing, dismissing, and updating overlay windows that simulate remote playback, with support for different Android API levels.

classes.name: OverlayDisplayWindow
classes.description: Abstract class managing overlay display windows on Android, providing methods to create, show, dismiss, and update window attributes, with specific implementations for different API levels.

classes.name: OverlayDisplayWindow.OverlayWindowListener
classes.description: Interface for listening to overlay window lifecycle events such as creation and destruction.

classes.name: OverlayDisplayWindow.LegacyImpl
classes.description: Implementation of overlay window management for older Android versions, using SurfaceView and WindowManager.

classes.name: OverlayDisplayWindow.JellybeanMr1Impl
classes.description: Implementation of overlay window management for API 17+ (Android 4.2+), using TextureView and advanced gesture handling for repositioning and resizing the overlay.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create an overlay window instance appropriate for the device's API level.

methods.name: setOverlayWindowListener
methods.description: Sets a listener to monitor window lifecycle events.

methods.name: updateAspectRatio
methods.description: Adjusts the overlay window's aspect ratio based on new width and height.
